description: Section structure, section word caps and token budget for a rule document in docs/code/. The prose authorities are docs/__meta__/code.md section 5 for the structure and section 1 (Avoid Context Bloat) for the length, which states the rule without fixing a number; this file is their machine-checkable half, and its caps and budget are that rule made decidable, set from the corpus as it stands. The order is: the document's own rule sections, then the Checklist, then the two reference sections, adjacent, with nothing after them. The word caps keep each section's prose concise: a word is a whitespace-delimited token of prose, and fenced code blocks and table rows are not counted, so an example costs no words. A section's cap covers its H3 children, and the cap on the `any` run applies to each of its sections alone. Rule is named here, ahead of the run, only for its own cap, since a namespace specification cannot lift this one's: Rule and Checklist each restate the whole document once, Rule before the examples and the Checklist after them. The reference sections are navigation and are not capped. The token budget is on the whole file, frontmatter, code and tables included: what loading it costs an agent, in o200k_base tokens whichever agent reads it.
